text: Standing in these spaces, I am filled with curiosity and reflection. The stark, clean glass of the first room gives a sense of order—perhaps a boundary before knowledge is acquired. Then, entering the colorful and engaging exhibit in the second image, I feel the invigorating energy of innovation and discovery. The invitation to explore how we connect with intelligent machines makes me ponder the nature of progress. I feel simultaneously excited and contemplative, aware of how environment shapes thought.
